string.text: Sewn-on side pockets and flaps. Slightly increase carry weight.
Expansion gussets for the main compartment. Noticeably increase carry weight.\n \nChoice: excludes "Lightweight frame".
Light alloy frame: a smaller carry weight bonus, but less stamina is spent while moving.\n \nChoice: excludes "Expanded volume".
Rigid cargo frame with extra lashing points. Maximum carry weight bonus.\n \nChoice: excludes "Compression straps".
Straps keep the load tight to the back: a small carry weight bonus and faster stamina recovery.\n \nChoice: excludes "Cargo frame".
The fabric is treated with a protective compound. Slightly weakens radiation and chemical damage to the wearer.
Leaded rubber sheets in the back panel and walls. Reduces incoming radiation.\n \nChoice: excludes "Chemical cover".
Sealed rubberized cover. Reduces chemical burn damage.\n \nChoice: excludes "Lead lining".
A layer of fire-resistant fibre and foil. Reduces fire and heat damage.\n \nChoice: excludes "Dielectric layer".
Insulating layer and a grounded frame rail. Reduces electric damage.\n \nChoice: excludes "Thermal insulation".
Wide padded shoulder straps. Reduce stamina spent while moving.
A load-bearing hip belt moves part of the weight to the hips. Speeds up stamina recovery.\n \nChoice: excludes "Kevlar insert".
A kevlar pack in the back panel. Reduces bullet, shrapnel and claw damage when hit from behind.\n \nChoice: excludes "Hip belt".
Adjustable suspension with a ventilated back panel. Considerably reduces stamina spent while moving.
Magazine and ammo pouches on the shoulder straps. Speed up loading and unloading of magazines.
Quick-access magazine flaps. Speed up weapon reloading and magazine loading.\n \nChoice: excludes "Light suspension".
A lightened suspension that does not restrict movement. Increases sprint and run speed.\n \nChoice: excludes "Quick pockets".
Reinforced straps with a sternum strap hold the load firmly. Increase jump height.\n \nChoice: excludes "Quick-access pouches".
Extra pouches on the belt and side straps. Even faster magazine loading and a little more carry weight.\n \nChoice: excludes "Reinforced straps".
A shielded artefact socket wired to the belt: +1 artefact slot (an outfit must be worn, 5 slots at most). Its lead lining also slightly reduces incoming radiation.
The compartment walls are reinforced with lead plates. Further reduces incoming radiation.\n \nChoice: excludes "Psi screen".
A mesh of shielding alloy in the backpack walls. Reduces psi damage to the wearer.\n \nChoice: excludes "Lead compartment".
A combined shielding module. Slightly reduces incoming radiation and psi damage.
Settings of the scripted backpack upgrade effects. Carry weight (kg) comes from configs and is not changed here.
Global multiplier for all scripted upgrade effects (protection, stamina, speed, reload).
Radiation, chemical, fire, electric, psi and the kevlar insert.
Reduced stamina drain and faster stamina recovery.
Faster reload animations and magazine loading (Mags Redux).
+1 artefact belt slot from the Container compartment upgrade.
Print the summed effects to the log whenever the backpack or its upgrades change.
